channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Meta rolls out a major upgrade: specialized models trained on Muse Wonder are now live across Muse and Meta AI
item.description: On November 6, Meta rolled out a dedicated Muse Wonder-based model to Muse and Meta AI, lifting a score from 38% to 47% and adding Active Memory. (AIbase)

item.title: Industry's largest embodied model challenge reaches finals: 15 teams set for 48-hour real-robot showdown
item.description: On Nov. 6, fifteen teams of 59 contestants advanced from 1,855 teams and 3,252 participants globally in the first Ant Lingbo Embodied Large Model Challenge, and will now face a 48-hour real-machine final. (AIbase)

item.title: He Xi 2077 AI Deep Signal Weekly 2026 W45: Execution Foundation, Acceptance Debt, and the Boundaries of Memory
item.description: Covering November 2–8, 2026, the weekly digest distills 194 AI news items into agent execution foundations, acceptance debt, and memory boundaries, citing HEELO’s 46 tasks and Terminal-Bench’s roughly 30% benchmark problems as lingering verification work. (Daily Digest)

item.title: Clone a Superstar in Seconds? Suno Hit With Another Infringement Suit
item.description: Elvis Presley’s music-rights owner and Eminem’s Eight Mile Style have sued Suno, alleging the AI platform can generate songs imitating famous artists’ melodies and styles within seconds. (AIbase)

item.title: Gurman says Siri could become an autonomous agent as soon as next year, taking on OpenAI and Meta head-on
item.description: Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports in Power On that Apple could as soon as next year upgrade Siri from passive command responses into an autonomous agent that tracks goals and decides next steps, competing with ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse and Grok. (AIbase)

item.title: Lab unicorn Sakana AI is launching an app as it pivots to consumers
item.description: Sakana AI, a Japanese unicorn valued above US$1 billion in 2024, is recruiting beta users for its first mobile app, Sakana AI App (working title), bringing evolutionary model merging from the cloud to phones and signaling a consumer shift. (AIbase)

item.title: [One Million AI Engineer Special] How Stanford Teaches AI-Native Engineering — Mihail Eric, Monaco
item.description: Latent Space’s million-subscriber special features Mihail Eric, who teaches Stanford’s Modern Software Developer course and leads AI at Monaco, debating whether repositories will become software factories. (Follow Builders · Podcast · Latent Space)

item.title: Microsoft has built a dedicated management system for a future where 200,000 employees will collaborate with 20 million AI agents
item.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella envisions 200,000 employees coordinating with 20 million AI agents, and this piece covers his test of 100 agents at once plus the resulting shift in enterprise human-AI collaboration and programming. (AIbase)

item.title: NVIDIA goes all in at Seoul AI Day: strikes major partnerships with Korean government, Samsung, LG, Hyundai
item.description: At its November 9 NVIDIA AI Day in Seoul, NVIDIA partnered with Korea’s MSIT and giants including Samsung, LG and Hyundai, while SK Telecom and three other foundation-model firms use NVIDIA Dynamo to optimize AI inference. (AIbase)

item.title: I don't believe there is any so-called "AI bubble
item.description: I don't believe there is any so-called "AI bubble (matteoraso.github.io)

item.title: Alibaba Cloud Token Plan raises quotas across all tiers: Pro tier drops 187 yuan, Lite entry plan just 19.5 yuan
item.description: Alibaba Cloud cut its Token Plan Pro tier from CNY499 to CNY312 per month—a 37% drop—and raised its quota to 200,000 Credits, with Lite entry now at CNY19.5 across four tiers. (AIbase)

item.title: anthropics/claude-quickstarts — A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API
item.description: anthropics/claude-quickstarts bundles Claude API starter projects for a customer support agent, financial data analysis, Computer Use and Browser Use, plus a macOS-native computer-use reference implementation demonstrating tool definitions and prompt caching. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: How I fight AI mental exhaustion
item.description: By putting Claude Code and Codex tasks into a git-based markdown ticket queue and an owner inbox for human-judgment items, the author handles one ticket at a time and closes context after finishing, countering switching across 20 threads. (sergeykuhne.com)

item.title: Llama-modchip: features a 284B DeepSeek chip, 64GB of memory, and no GPU
item.description: llama-modchip runs a 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash model entirely on a 64GB CPU with zero GPUs, using under 59GiB of RAM and decoding at 9.1–14.7 tok/s across a 256K context window. (github.com)

item.title: OpenAI raises $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
item.description: OpenAI raised roughly $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation—only 37% of its original $30 billion target—and the shortfall’s effects on Microsoft and NVIDIA are analyzed. (247wallst.com)

item.title: Taking Sides in the Storm: Musk Backs Jensen Huang with a Simple "I Agree
item.description: On November 9, Elon Musk reposted a post about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on X with just "I agree," backing Huang after his apology to Nvidia staff over an extramarital affair, with Musk stressing Huang's irreplaceability. (AIbase)

item.title: Why I don't use large language models for programming
item.description: Why I don't use large language models for programming (www.polso.info)

item.title: Silicon Valley Promises AI Will Cure Disease. Drugmaker CEOs Aren't Buying It
item.description: WSJ reports that Silicon Valley's claims that AI will cure disease are meeting skepticism from drugmaker CEOs, laying out both sides' arguments and evidence over AI's prospects in drug discovery.

item.title: Goldman Sachs is pulling Claude Code from its bankers and traders
item.description: Goldman Sachs is pulling Claude Code and GitHub access from bankers and traders, returning it to about 12,000 engineers weeks before taking Anthropic public; traders had used the AI agents to monitor client trading flows and model markets.

item.title: Anthropic spends $3.4B to snap up power generation equipment and boost energy supply for its data centers
item.description: Anthropic’s September deal with OnePWR Solutions, worth $3.4 billion, covers 1.7 GW of heavy-duty generator sets plus installation, described as the largest single power-equipment purchase by an AI company to date. (AIbase)
